messages.subject: error when inspecting first.order information
parts:
Hi Yves,

Apologies for posting this twice, but I didn't know whether you preferred a bug report here or on github.  (And I know you are still on sabbatical, so I don't expect an immediate reply.)

This happens with both 0.5-20 and the latest development version (0.5-21.933):

example(cfa)
lavInspect(fit, "information.first.order")
example(sem)
lavInspect(fit, "augmented.information.first.order")

Same error message in either case:

Error in t(Delta[[g]]) %*% B1 : non-conformable arguments

Thanks,

Terry
